title: run_report.json (v1.0)
description: Per-run optimizer report. Companion to subgraphsdata.json. See REFACTOR_GOALS.md §3-2.
$comment: Root is open within v1.x to allow additive minor evolution (e.g. aggregate `layers[]` per §1-1-a item 3, `cross_impl_delta` per §2). trace[].items stays strict — that's the load-bearing contract for plot_convergence.

schema_version.description: Major.minor; v1.x is the eval-count iter-semantics regime (§1-1-a risk note).

config.description: Mirror of subgraphsdata.json `General Parameters`. Free-form to track optimizer/loss params.

iter.description: loss_function call count (eval-count semantics, NOT SA outer iter).

wall_ms.description: Milliseconds since Optimizer.optimize() entry; same origin as timings.optimization_wall_ms.

is_new_best.description: True iff loss < best_so_far at the time of this eval (sink-computed).

timings.description: Phase wall-clock totals in milliseconds. Phase names are conventional but not enumerated here — each milestone may add new phases.

summary.$comment: Open within v1.x: M3+ may add per-layer stats; §1-2-b 验收口径 names `cross_impl_delta` as a future field.

best_at_iter.description: -1 only when iterations == 0 (no eval was ever recorded).

layers.description: Per-layer aggregate stats (§1-1-a item 3). Optional in v1.x; present when the orchestrator calls RunRecorder.set_aggregate(...).

crosslayer_crossings_total.description: Total interlayer crossings across all layer pairs (§1-1-a item 3). Post-2026-05-15 default = 1 * geometric events (convention='geometric', matches paper reporting); pass waveguides_per_link=2 for the physical convention (convention='physical') aligned with the loss model's implicit 2x. See REFACTOR_GOALS.md §4 M3 附注 + §7 Q-e.

crosslayer_crossings_convention.description: Whether crosslayer_crossings_total has been multiplied by waveguides_per_link. 'geometric' = no (wpl=1, post-2026-05-15 default, matches paper reporting); 'physical' = yes (wpl=2, opt-in, matches loss model's implicit 2x); 'experimental' = wpl in {3,4,...,32} where the stats label is documented as semantically distinct from the loss model — see REFACTOR_GOALS.md §4 M3 附注 'Warning 策略' + §7 Q-e. The constructor/loader notice is the runtime signal; this field is the durable record for offline readers.
